meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Can hide Uppbeat's current annual-discount banner; shared cleanup rules are best-effort
meta.notes: **Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out in desktop Chromium at https://uppbeat.io/. `[data-banner-id="annual-sale-ARTISTMADE"]` matched the top annual-sale banner once; its option is off by default. Cookie, Google-ad-slot and generic app-banner selectors each matched 0 on the homepage. Other routes, locales and logged-in pages were not checked. The real fixture is a sanitized excerpt of the banner and a protected site-navigation link.
